objective: Aggressively optimize WRITE-COST-01 with changed-area tests and small local timing before expansion.

policy.scope: Aggressive local write optimization after WRITE-COST-01; no retained 100k/provider restart or full gate.
policy.stop: Block new trial/operation admission, cooperative cancellation and accepted callback drain, normal unmount of only new owned probe views. Preserve evidence. No force-kill of product writer, ACK relaxation or timeout extension. Diagnose a local overrun before expanding.
policy.qualification: Small actual/fake-basis probes and changed-area tests first. Keep all unfavorable/intermediate blocks separate; no whole 100k speedup from local probes.

changes.ST-83: Exact no-write/no-delete writer append cursor avoids repeated length queries and redundant seeks that disrupt buffering. Read-moved position is restored; append/flush failure invalidates cursor and re-reads actual tail. Reopen/header/native ownership and durable root boundaries remain. Internal counters expose shared FlushIndexBatch time, complete nodes and logical page bytes without public schema changes.
changes.ST-84: Mixed callback gathering targets 2–8 current open handles rather than stopping at two mutations; EWMA service cost selects a nominal 20–250us cooperative yield budget, without timer sleep or mutation/journal gates. Existing 64 callback/chunk and 16MiB limits/ACK/drain/poison remain. Supported-store Open can bypass batching only after nonblocking mutation-gate admission proves no queued callback or running leader. Contended/queued Open retains FIFO and post-durability handle retention. New mixed/idle diagnostics are internal and not added to public command state fields.
changes.ST-85: Only new opportunistic packed-to-packed sources additionally require at least 25% dead bytes, bounding live copying to 3:1 dead bytes, while retaining the 4KiB absolute gate. First normal-journal packing, explicit force, existing pending planning and persisted candidate/row recovery retain full cleanup. Sorted rows use shared-budget MetadataSpool with disk fallback; only admitted sources build persistent AllRows, and per-source selection is reused across a source group. Frozen/native/content checks and all formats remain.
changes.ST-86: Focused ACK/failure/interruption/handle/replay and packing reader/concurrent-edit/same-request recovery tests; forced scratch pressure covers disk spool. Record all candidate blocks, failures, the accidentally broad validation overrun and preserved 100k/native closeout.

formats: Task v4/basis v3/overlay v3/SPM2 and journal/control/CLI/wire formats unchanged; no new public capability or command field.

validation.testSourceNote: Final product was unchanged during these groups. The test-only rebuild extends packing InlineData with scratch pressure; its five cases replace the earlier three-case packing-new-c group in the unique count.

incidents.detail: Nullable output dereference failed first compile; corrected before validation.
New timed tests omitted cancellation-token references required by xUnit analyzer; corrected. Test-only rebuild 7.91s then passed.
Combined class/method filters selected zero tests; not counted. Replaced with explicit method OR selection.
Sandbox denied atomic file rename in all five tests; preserved failures. The same NTFS tests passed under the authorized ordinary-user native execution environment.
Probe attempted to call internal SetBatch directly; corrected to reflection against both frozen candidates.

Class-wide metadata selection accidentally included 32769/262145/1048576-entry tests (0.912/4.826/18.492s). Ctrl-C request arrived after successful exit, so no process was killed or actually canceled. Preserve the late stop check; 48 passes/1 skip do not erase it. Explicit one-case append-small-c rerun passed before further native work.

qualifications: 115 unique changed-area passes and two opt-in cost skips, small synthetic metadata/packing components and 15 real native views with fake fixed basis only.
